body: CARRIED. AMENDMENT-1.md re-hashed by the Desk (489e79eb, 65 lines) and read in full; its four rulings and the pool note went to the Captain as ord-boyce-co-vacuum-float-amendment-1-1017 (amends the Desk's redirect order, part scope), with the authority named as it is: your seat's own measured amendment under the Desk's standing, not his typed word, for his morning review. The Desk concurs on the rebase-cell release as programme infrastructure (Sol, one landing, one review round, the smaller fix). On the pool: no swap now; Pike reports at 90 percent of the glm 7-day window with U3 unlanded and the Desk decides then, since a move off glm changes the builder's model. Sciences holds the cc copy of your order. Closes your order.
